description.en: The name of the bucket to query.

title.zh: 获取存储空间存储容量与文件数量
title.en: Retrieve bucket storage capacity and object count

descriptions.zh:
- 调用该接口时需要拥有oss:GetBucketStat权限。
- 调用该接口获取的数据并非是实时数据，延时可能超过一个小时。
- 调用该接口获取到的存储信息的时间点不保证是最新的，即后一次调用该接口返回的LastModifiedTime字段值可能比前一次调用该接口返回的LastModifiedTime字段值小。
descriptions.en:
- You must have the oss:GetBucketStat permission to call this operation.
- The data returned by this operation is not real-time. The latency can exceed one hour.
- The point in time of the storage information returned by this operation is not guaranteed to be the latest. The LastModifiedTime value returned by a subsequent call may be earlier than the LastModifiedTime value returned by a previous call.
